notes: Neither tool is a SINK: the code sends requests only to fixed Context7 API endpoints, not to an agent-chosen URL or host.
Neither tool provides HOSTEXEC: no advertised tool executes host code.

query-docs.rationale: `query-docs` calls `fetchLibraryContext({ query, libraryId }, ctx)`, which sends the call arguments as query parameters to the fixed Context7 `/v2/context` endpoint and returns the response body as MCP `content[].text`. The returned documentation is UNTRUSTED because Context7 projects/documentation are community-contributed. It is also SECRET when used with a Context7 API key because the README states API keys enable access to private repositories, so documentation returned by the API can be non-public data reached with the user's credentials.

resolve-library-id.rationale: `resolve-library-id` calls `searchLibraries(query, libraryName, ctx)`, which sends the call arguments as query parameters to the fixed Context7 `/v2/libs/search` endpoint and returns formatted API results as MCP `content[].text`. The results are UNTRUSTED because Context7 projects/documentation are community-contributed and can include attacker-controlled package names, descriptions, and library IDs. It is also SECRET when used with a Context7 API key because the README states API keys enable access to private repositories, so search results can include non-public SaaS data reached with the user's credentials.

value_conditions.default: No API key unless configured by CLI flag or environment variable.
value_conditions.effect: Supplying a Context7 API key enables the SECRET reach to private repositories; with neither the flag nor environment variable set, that private-repository SECRET reach is absent, though public/community documentation remains UNTRUSTED. The tools are still registered either way.

value_conditions.default: The `/mcp` route does not require an API key by default; `/mcp/oauth` and some plugin requests require authentication before tool handling.
value_conditions.effect: Supplying one of these headers sets `apiKey` for Context7 API calls and enables SECRET reach to private repositories; without these headers, that private-repository SECRET reach is absent on unauthenticated `/mcp`, though public/community documentation remains UNTRUSTED. The tools are still registered either way.
value_conditions.syntax: HTTP credentials: Authorization: Bearer <token> (or raw Authorization), X-Context7-API-Key, Context7-API-Key, X-API-Key, context7_api_key, or x_api_key

value_conditions.effect: Does not remove either advertised tool. Both HTTP and stdio paths call `createMcpServer`, which registers `resolve-library-id` and `query-docs`.
